discrete.label: [CA] discrete grid + Pert_H enclosure (cert_core entry rads ~0 at prec64; use N13 Pert_H)
discrete.note: Certifies rho of equal-weight average over the 38 grid twists, with MH radii from cert_core. Does NOT certify the continuum integral average (Lip mesh error too large at Nq=48).

continuum.label: [CA]
continuum.note: ||K_cont - K_grid||_HS <= err_Ad_mesh (+ radii). With Nq=48 this is LARGE (~10). Continuum rho NOT certified near 0.223. Discrete grid operator IS the certified object.
